name: The Art of Creation
storyline:
This tale begins with the creation of two angelic beings. Their deity adores them but there is something off about the affection they're given. The angels feel uncomfortable in their own skin and the idea of having relations with the other sickens them, however, they have no idea why they feel so repulsed.

The couple is told they can roam the garden they're born in but warned to never eat from the "Tree of Knowledge" as if they do they will meet a horrible end. Contrary to the Deity's word, a demonic Serpent appears claiming the Deity is full of lies. The Serpent tells one of the angels that should they eat the tree's fruit they will find out why their body feels so strange and why they lack any attraction to the being they were created for.
summary: This horror based visual novel is a retelling of the story of Adam & Eve in a queer context that strives to eliminate the stigma certain religions can hold towards members of the LGBTQ+ community.
